summary: Iteration 43 — Emergent email proxy migration (Resend → integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send). Backend pytest: 20 passed, 2 intentionally skipped (duplicate email paths to respect proxy rate limits — kept under user's ≤6 real-email budget). Features (1)–(9) all green. (1) GET /api/integrations returns new values schema (reply_to_email, notification_emails, warehouse_email, twilio_*) with resend_api_key/sender_email removed; status.email_ready=true, status.email_sender='Hayah Energy', status.email_reply_to='lucasciqueiraeng@hotmail.com', from_env.reply_to_email=true. PUT with reply_to_email='x@y.com' persisted (from_env=false), restored with empty string (from_env=true). (2) POST /api/integrations/test-email → external 'alguem@externo.com' rejected 400 'cadastrados'; own admin email → 200 {status:'sent', id, to:[admin]}; non-admin request without auth → 401. (3) Material requisition full flow: PUT warehouse_email=admin → created test project + manual material → POST /api/materials/request (multipart signature_name='Teste' notes='teste e-mail' requisition_type='total') → 200 {status:'sent', id, requisition_id}; last material_requisitions entry has email_status='sent', email_id set, email_links[0].url matches https://.../api/public/files/<token>. (3b) Unauth GET on the public URL → 200 application/pdf with Content-Disposition attachment and payload starting with %PDF. (3c) Invalid token (same base path + 'tokeninvalido_xxx') → 404. (4) POST /api/projects/{id}/requisitions/{req_id}/resend → 200 {status:'sent'}; new material_requisitions entry has is_resend=true and populated email_links. (5) Medição: PUT labor_measured with one line → POST /medicao/enviar with 'fiscal.novo@externo.com' → 400 'Cadastre o fiscal'; with save_fiscais=true and recipients=[admin] → 200 {status:'sent', envio.status:'sent', envio.email_id}. (6) Lembrete de licença: licenca/config set warning (paid_until=today+3 Cuiabá), ran licenca.reminder_tick directly (hora Cuiabá=22:xx ≥ 08:00) → {status:'sent'} and app_settings{key:'license'}.reminder_sent_on=today_cuiaba; second call same day → None (1x/dia idempotency). (7) Safety gate _assert_safe_email unit tests: rejects <form>/<input> (G2), rejects http:// (G3), rejects credential-ask phrases, accepts https; email_service.links_html(...) and licenca.reminder_html(...) pass the gate. (8) POST /api/notifications/test/vencidas with email channel → results.email.status='sent' when notification_emails configured. (9) Frontend smoke /configuracoes: integrations-panel renders 'E-mail · gerenciado pela Emergent' section with integ-email-status='Ativo', integ-email-sender text='Hayah Energy (nome da Marca branca)', fields integ-reply_to_email/integ-notification_emails/integ-warehouse_email present; integ-resend_api_key and integ-sender_email absent; sending test-email to external triggers toast error with text containing 'cadastr'; /materiais loads with histórico; /medicao mo-enviar button renders in medição page. Cleanup: license disabled, reminder_sent_on unset, warehouse_email/notification_emails/reply_to_email cleared, test projects deleted.

minor.issue: Rate limiting is aggressive — bursty parallel sends (≥2 in ~2s) immediately return HTTP 429 'email rate limit exceeded' and the ban persists ~1–3 minutes. In pytest-xdist (-n 2 default) email tests fire in parallel across workers and hit 429 chains that also cascade into Cloudflare 502s on long-running endpoints (e.g. /api/materials/request) because the backend keeps retrying through 429s while the request stays open. Workaround applied: ran tests with -n 0 serial and inserted 35s throttle between every real send. Not a product bug — proxy behavior — but note: tests involving real email must run serial or carry explicit per-test throttles.

issues: Sender description reads 'sem conta ou chave Resend' — intentional confirmation of migration. Fine, but if the brand wants to fully drop 'Resend' from UI copy, consider rephrasing to 'sem chave externa de e-mail' to future-proof against another SDK swap. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py is well-contained (~208 lines): send_email always returns a dict (never raises), applies _assert_safe_email before dispatch, logs 429/5xx distinctly. attachments_to_links refuses http:// FRONTEND_URL and omits attachments gracefully; token is secrets.token_urlsafe(24) with 30-day TTL and downloads counter. build_public_router handles 404 (not found), 410 (expired), 500 (storage read failure) and increments downloads atomically.

G3 anchor-vs-host rule in _assert_safe_email is correct but subtle: real filenames with underscores or non-ASCII bytes don't trigger _HOSTISH, while filenames like 'f.pdf' or 'arquivo.pdf' do — and will fail the gate if the link host doesn't contain that TLD. Current real-world flow uses 'requisicao_<CODE>.pdf' which contains an underscore and therefore escapes _HOSTISH — safe. Recommendation: either (a) strip the trailing '.pdf' from the anchor text in links_html to make the rule insensitive to filename shape, or (b) relax G3 to only trigger when _HOSTISH matches more than just a bare 'word.pdf' pattern. Current behavior passed all real sends.

/api/materials/request and resend handlers correctly persist email_links in material_requisitions and don't break the flow when the proxy is skipped/errors (push happens on every branch). Good resilience.

medicao.enviar_medicao escapes body.message via html.escape before injecting into medicao_email_html — HTML in message won't bypass the gate. send_email error branch raises 502 (correct), skipped branch raises 503 (correct).

licenca.reminder_tick is idempotent per day via app_settings.reminder_sent_on=<ISO date Cuiabá>; it only fires ≥08:00 Cuiabá and inside the warning window (days_left ≤ 5 and ≥ −7). Verified end-to-end.

notifications.get_integrations_view masks SECRET_FIELDS correctly and returns from_env flags so the UI can show which fields are inherited from env. _admin() guard uniform across integration endpoints.

pytest.ini pins xdist at -n 2 — this collides with real-email tests that mutate shared backend state (reply_to_email, warehouse_email, notification_emails) and burst-send to a rate-limited proxy. Suggestion: add a 'serial' marker and the iteration-43 file sets its own -n 0 override (user runs tests serially).

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 relevant tests passed; 2 skipped by design)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all integ-* selectors present, test-email guard works, Resend fields removed)

Also created transient db.email_files records from attachments_to_links — not cleaned (30-day TTL, orphan on delete, acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Emergent email proxy enforces aggressive rate limits (≈1 email per 30s). Any test that sends real email MUST (a) run serial (pytest -n 0 or dedicated marker), (b) wait ≥30s between sends, (c) stay under 6 real sends per iteration (user policy). The _throttle() helper in test_iteration43.py uses 35s between sends — reuse that pattern. If a test burst 429s, wait 180s before retrying — the ban persists. Also: for medicao tests, labor_measured must be seeded via PUT /medicao/realizado before POST /medicao/enviar — recipients must be in project.fiscais OR equal current_user.email (save_fiscais=true auto-registers). For material/request, warehouse_email must be set via PUT /api/integrations before calling the endpoint — otherwise 400. For public download tests, the base path is '<FRONTEND_URL>/api/public/files/<token>' — invalid token returns 404 (not 410, which is reserved for expired links).
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bug surfaced. Only testing-process RCA: pytest-xdist parallel workers burst-sent to the rate-limited proxy, so first attempt saw 9 cascading failures (429 → backend retry → Cloudflare 502). Mitigation: serial run (-n 0) + 35s throttle + skip duplicate-path tests to keep real sends ≤6. All 20 relevant tests passed after mitigation.
